text.p: Brief profile of Nicolas Kiefer of Germany who beat Russian third seed Yevgeny Kafelnikov in the fourth round of the men's singles at Wimbledon on Tuesday:
Kiefer is competing at his first Wimbledon and only his third career Grand Slam.

An outstanding junior, he made his Grand Slam debut in the Australian Open as a qualifier, but went out to Mark Philippoussis in the opening round and also lost in the first round at the 1997 French Open.
His progress here has increased his Grand Slam win/loss tally to 4-2.
In 1995 he won the Australian and U.S. Open boy's titles and was also a junior finalist at Wimbledon where lost to Olivier Mutis of France.
Born in Holzminden, Kiefer now lives in Sievershansen near Hanover. He celebrates his 20th birthday on Saturday.

Unseeded: Age: 19. Plays: Right-handed. Weight: 72 kg. Height: 1.80m. Ranking: 98. Tournament wins: 0. Head-to-head: One match v Kafelnikov, second round at Halle last month, lost 7-6 7-6. Career prize money: $159,448. Next opponent: Todd Woodbridge (Australia).
